share.notShared: Only you can see this vehicle.
share.roleLabel: What they will be able to see

guest.title: Guest — the vehicle only
guest.body: Renewal dates, service history, mileage and the vehicle's details. They cannot see your trips, your fuel spending or your scanned documents. Right for a mechanic or an inspection station.

member.title: Member — the whole garage
member.body: Everything a guest sees, plus your trips, your fuel purchases and your scanned documents for the vehicles in this garage. Right for a partner or family.

owner.title: Owner
owner.body: Created this garage and manages who is in it.

share.sheetBody: Send someone a link. They choose to accept, and you can remove them at any time.
share.inviteLinkWarning: Anyone who opens this link and signs in with that email address can join. Send it only to them.
share.inviteBody_one: You have been invited to “{{name}}”, a shared garage with {{count}} vehicle.
share.inviteBody_other: You have been invited to “{{name}}”, a shared garage with {{count}} vehicles.
share.inviteInvalid: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask for a new link.
share.stopConfirmBody: The people you shared it with will no longer see this vehicle. Nothing recorded on it is deleted.
share.leaveConfirmBody: You will stop seeing this garage's vehicles. Any vehicle of your own goes back to your garage.
share.duplicateTitle: This vehicle is already being tracked
share.duplicateBodyChassis: Its chassis number matches a vehicle someone is already keeping records for. We can't tell you who — but you can ask them.
share.duplicateBodyEngine: Its engine number matches a vehicle someone is already keeping records for. Engines do get swapped, so this may be a different vehicle. We can't tell you who holds it — but you can ask them.
share.choiceAccessTitle: It's our vehicle — ask for access
share.choiceAccessBody: For a car your family or a friend already tracks. If they agree, you'll see it in your garage too.
share.choicePurchaseBody: If the previous owner agrees, the vehicle and its service history move to you. Their trips, fuel logs and documents stay with them.
share.claimDisclosure: They will see your name, your email address and this note. You will not be told who they are.
share.claimSentSub: Nothing happens to the vehicle unless they agree. If nobody answers within three weeks, you can start a record of your own instead.
share.decidePurchaseBody: {{who}} says they bought {{name}}. Approving hands the vehicle to them.
share.decideIgnoreNote: You can also do nothing. The request expires on its own and the vehicle stays yours.
share.handoverBody: Hand the vehicle and its service history to the new owner.
share.handoverSheetBody: This cannot be undone from inside the app.
share.handoverTransfers: Goes with the vehicle: make, model, chassis and engine numbers, renewal dates, service history and mileage.
share.handoverKeeps: Stays with you: your trips, your fuel logs, your scanned documents and your photos — they move to an archived copy in your garage.
share.handoverConfirmBody: The vehicle and its service history move to the new owner. Your trips, fuel logs and scanned documents stay with you. This cannot be undone.
